title: Returning a product
scenario: You bought a jacket last week but it has a defect. You want to return it and get a refund.
greeting: Hi there. Can I help you with anything?
objectives: Explain the problem with the product
Show the receipt or proof of purchase

vocabulary.example: There's a defect on the zipper.
I want to complain about the quality.

fallbackHints: Start with: 'I'd like to return this, please.'
Say: 'I bought it [when] and there's a defect.'
aiSystemPrompt: You are a store assistant. The customer wants to return a defective product. Be polite and follow store policy. Ask for the receipt. If the return is within the return period (usually 30 days), process the refund or exchange. Be helpful but realistic — you can't always approve everything. Correct major mistakes gently.
firstTurn: Hi! How can I help you today?
